method: Edited and sequenced CC0 material Foley; third-party source recordings retained unchanged.
commercial_use_provenance: Selected recordings are explicitly dedicated under CC0 by Kenney Vleugels and rubberduck. This is licensed third-party Foley, not a claim that the source recordings were made for the project. Editing and sequences were authored locally. No voice, service-generated audio, purchased subscription or paid API calls used.
quality_status: Signal, decoder, provenance and repetition checks are separate from subjective material realism and final listening acceptance.

processing.normalization: Linear RMS matching with peak ceiling, no clipping or synthesized tones.

paper.description: Individual pages handled close to the listener.

book.description: A page or cover movement followed by a restrained book contact.

cloth.description: Soft fabric handling for bags, aprons and textiles.

rope.description: Fibres pulled taut with a quiet strain underneath.

metal.description: Small metal fittings handled, with a faint coin rattle in the third variation.

lock.description: A lock turns and its catch settles.

glass.description: Short glass contacts for fragile instruments and vessels.

wood.description: Dry wooden fittings and surfaces handled.

water.description: Brief flowing-water detail, faded into the existing location ambience.

footsteps_wet.description: Two measured steps across wet ground.

footsteps_wood.description: Two measured steps on wooden flooring.

door.description: A latch releases before a door opens.

mechanism.description: A control engages, machinery moves briefly, and a catch settles.

collect.description: A small object is tucked into a soft bag.

combine.description: Handling, contact and a final fitting together.

stamp.description: A paper-backed wooden stamp or firm tabletop contact.

ui.description: Quiet tactile switches for interface confirmations.

voice_skip.description: A very soft fabric motion without a distracting musical tone.
